test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: SRD Prasad received the Padma Shri in 2023, for his contribution to the sport of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalaripayattu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SRD Prasad:**

 
 
• **Padma Shri 2023** has been given to **Kerala's Kalaripayattu Acharya SRD Prasad** in recognition of his services to sports.
 
• The martial technique that SRD Prasad Gurukkal learned from** his father, Chirakkal T. Sreedharan Nair,** a legendary figure in Kalaripayattu, has been a lifelong study and teaching endeavour for him.
 
• Respected and experienced in the world of kalarippayattu, Prasad is also a skilled author and orator with mastery over the martial artform.
 
• He is the **recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademy award.**
 
• He** operates the well-known SRD Prasad Gurukul **to educate interested parties about the specialised art form.
 
 
 
• **Kalaripayattu**:
 
 
• The words **"Kalari" (meaning gym or training area) and "payattu" (meaning to battle or exercise)** are the origin of the phrase Kalaripayattu.
 
• **Kerala** is where Kalaripayattu, one of the **world's oldest and most scientific martial arts**, originated.
 
• Praised as Kerala's pride, it enjoys international recognition and esteem.
 
• The first step of the training is to massage the body with oil until it is supple and agile.
 
• Other essential elements of the **art form are feats like marichil (somersault), ottam (running), and chattom (jumping).**
 
• Additionally, there are instruction in the** use of weapons such as maces, swords, daggers, spears, and bows and arrows. **
 
• The ultimate goal is complete mental-body synergy. Kalaripayattu also emphasises specialising in traditional medical methods. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Padma Shri:

 
 
• The Padma Shri, which is also written Padma Shree, is the fourth-highest civilian honor granted by the Indian Republic, ranking behind the Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, and Padma Bhushan.
 
• Awardees are chosen for their "distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, acting, medicine, social service and public affairs."
 
• The award was established on January 2, 1954.
 
• Every year on India's Republic Day, the Indian government bestows this honour.
